app_subtitle: A school diary you can hear, in your own language.
home_guide: Scan the sticker on a child's diary, or sign in.
no_voice: This phone has no voice for this language.
offline_banner: No network. You can still record.
demo_privacy: This is a shared demo that resets every night. Do not enter real children's details.
demo_try_help: Tap a person to use the app as them. No password needed.
demo_simulate_help: Tap a card. It works like scanning that child's sticker.
i_am_here_as: I am using the app as
login_clerk_guide: Sign in with your mobile number, your Google account or a username.
otp_demo_banner: Demo sign-in. No SMS is sent. Your code:
auth_not_configured: Sign-in is not available. Please ask your school office.
setup_help: Tell us the school's name. You become its owner.
setup_sign_in_first: First sign in. That account becomes the school owner.
qr_per_student_help: Scan the diary, then speak. Fastest for teachers.
qr_per_school: One QR for the whole school
qr_per_school_help: Print once. The teacher picks the child after scanning.
link_guide: Is {child} your child? Ask the teacher to connect you.
link_pending: Request sent to {child}'s teacher. This screen changes when the teacher says yes.
link_rejected: The teacher did not approve this phone. Please talk to the teacher.
admin_cannot_record: Only this class's teachers can record a note.
school_unlinked: No child is connected to this number yet. Ask the teacher for your child's sticker.
consent_stored: We keep your child's name, class, your phone number and the voice notes.
consent_who: Only you, approved family and your child's teachers can hear them.
consent_ai: Voice recordings are sent to a cloud AI service to write and translate the words.
consent_delete: You can ask to delete your data at any time.
notifications_off: Notifications are off. You can turn them on in browser settings.
scan_guide: Point the camera at the QR sticker.
qr_not_ours: This is not a Vidya Vaani sticker.
qr_inactive: This QR is no longer active. Ask the teacher for a new sticker.
scan_try_again: Hold the phone steady, or use the list.
noisy: It's a bit noisy. Hold the phone near your mouth.
silence: I couldn't hear anything. Please speak again.
retry_unclear: The voice was not clear. Please speak again.
offline_saved: No network. The note is saved on the phone.
offline_will_send: It will be sent when the network returns.
mic_blocked: The microphone is blocked. Allow it, or type the note.
mic_missing: No microphone could be opened. You can type the note.
only_teachers_record: Only teachers of this class can record notes.
class_empty: No children in this class yet.
check_words: Check these words. Tap one to say it again.
respeak_help: Tap the microphone and say only that word.
no_words_yet: No written words. Parents will hear your voice.
mismatch_warning: The clean version changed a number or name, so your original words are shown.
low_confidence: The words may be wrong. Parents will also hear your voice.
approximate_transcript: Approximate words, written in a nearby language.
audio_only: Only your voice is saved for this language. Add a type with one tap.
transcript_pending: The words are not ready yet. Your voice is saved.
remind: Remind those who have not heard
diary_empty: Scan the sticker on your child's diary.
week_nothing_due: Nothing due in the next 7 days.
no_notes_yet: No notes yet. They will appear here.
privacy_intro: What is stored and who can hear it.
delete_my_data_confirm: This removes your link to your child, your listening history and your replies. It cannot be undone.
teacher_home_guide: Scan a diary, or choose a class.
no_classes: No class yet. Ask the school admin to add you.
school_qr_mode_note: This school uses one QR for everyone.
new_qr_confirm: The old sticker of {name} will stop working. Use this if a diary is lost.
new_qr_done: New QR made. Print the new sticker.
delete_student_confirm: Delete {name} and all notes meant only for them. This cannot be undone.
parent_email_help: A parent who signs in with this email is connected at once.
add_speak_guide: Say the child's name and the parent's number.
add_paste_guide: Paste one child on each line: name, then number.
students_invalid: Check the number or email for: {names}
duplicate_message: {name} looks like {existing}, already in this class.
voice_form_unavailable: Could not fill the form by voice. Please type.
print_guide: Print on A4 paper, then cut and paste on diaries.
stickers_school_mode: This school scans one QR for everyone. Stickers for each child work too.
print_scale: In the print window choose A4 paper and 100% size.
poster_line: Scan to hear school notes in your language.
inbox_empty: No replies yet. Parents' voice replies appear here.
help_intro: The app needs the microphone to record and the camera to scan.
help_tap_lock: Tap the lock sign next to the web address.
help_site_permissions: Open Sites and downloads, then Site permissions.
help_tap_aa: Tap aA next to the web address.
keep_notes: Years to keep notes after the school year
add_teacher_voice: Say the name, number and subjects
phone_or_email: Give a mobile number, an email, or both.
promote_guide: Everyone moves up. Choose Stays or Left for any child who does not.
promote_confirm: Move {n} children from {from} to {to} for {year}. Old notes stay with each child.
metric_before_due: Fee and exam notes heard in time
ai_calls: AI calls in the last 7 days
outcomes_help: The app cannot see these by itself. Enter what teachers report.
push_approval: A parent is asking to connect to {child}.
err_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err_phone_or_email_needed: Give a mobile number or an email.
err_phone_email_belong_to_different_peop: The number and email belong to different people.
err_otp_expired: The code has expired. Ask for a new one.
err_otp_too_many_attempts: Too many tries. Ask for a new code.
err_otp_too_many_sends: Too many codes sent. Wait 15 minutes.
err_too_many_requests: Too many tries. Wait a little.
err_clerk_token_invalid: Sign-in did not work. Please try again.
err_nudged_recently: A reminder was sent less than an hour ago.
err_already_set_up: The school is already set up.
install_body: Open it from your phone screen.
install_menu_choose: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
install_inapp: Opened this from WhatsApp or another app? Open it in Chrome first.
family_signin_detail: Record notes, or hear your child's notes
school_login_guide: For the principal and school office staff.
family_only_notice: This is the teacher and parent sign-in. School office staff sign in separately.
err_not_school_staff: This account is not registered as school office staff.
err_school_sign_in_needed: Please use the school office sign-in.
no_classes_yet: No class yet. Add the first one.
config_intro: Technical settings and service status, for whoever looks after the app.
config_keys_help: Keys are set in the hosting settings (the .env file or Netlify environment variables). They are never shown here.
config_without_nvidia: Without an NVIDIA key the app uses the phone for speech and shows translation as unavailable.
voice_help: Families who listen in Hindi or English hear your translated notes in this voice. In your own language they hear your recording.
voice_saved: {name} will now speak your translated notes.
voice_sample: Namaste. This is how your note will sound.
voice_missing: This phone has no {language} voice, so you hear the original recording.
